content.title: Permianville: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — Permianville Royalty Trust (PVL) on Friday reported net income of $528,000 in its third quarter. The Houston-based company said it had net income of 2 cents per share. The oil and gas statutory trust posted revenue of $11.6 million in the period.

content.title: Permianville: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — Permianville Royalty Trust (PVL) on Thursday reported profit of $282,000 in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Houston-based company said it had net income of 1 cent. The oil and gas statutory trust posted revenue of $11.2 million in the period.
